match_stages.stage_name: No Need To Believe In Either Side
match_stages.stage_briefing:
No Need to Believe in Either Side is a 16 round, 80-point, Comstock Speed Shoot. There are 6 USPSA targets and 4 USPSA Mini poppers. The best 2 hits per paper will score and steel must fall to score.

The handgun start position is standing inside shooting area, wrists below belt with handgun loaded and holstered.

The PCC start position is standing inside shooting area, holding loaded PCC with safety on, stock on belt, and muzzle pointing downrange.

On the audible start signal from within shooting area, engage T1-T2 and P1-P4 or T3-T6, perform a mandatory reload between arrays and engage remaining targets. You may engage arrays in any order.
